title: portfolio
summary: This Next.js site: the public surface for project records, contact paths, and deployment cleanup.
whyItMatters: Shows App Router implementation, Payload-backed content wiring, production deployment cleanup, and package-manager authority.
intent: Useful as infrastructure context in the full project record. It is not treated as the strongest homepage evidence.

title: review-game-core
summary: Concept-layer toolkit for study products: TypeScript primitives, workflow contracts, and documentation that can support multiple learning apps.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates domain modeling, reusable abstractions, documentation as a product interface, and a clear testing doctrine for user-facing learning workflows.
intent: Active system work. Intended to support consumer-facing study tools while proving the underlying concepts in public.

title: astronomy-future-compute
summary: Interactive astronomy presentation rebuilt in Next.js with live controls, a deployed site, and visible progression through the story.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates turning a static presentation idea into a usable web experience with navigation, interaction design, and browser-validated workflow behavior.
intent: Shipped product example showing educational or presentation content behaving like a real interface.

title: About-Me
summary: YAML-to-LaTeX document pipeline for resumes, CVs, cover letters, portfolio exports, and agent-assisted tailoring.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates automation around structured content, document generation, repeatable workflows, and the ability to connect personal tooling to a public product surface.
intent: Active companion system. The next step is tighter integration with the portfolio and clearer generated-document publishing.

title: lfx
summary: Go CLI for managing lf themes, icons, and plugins: a small terminal control plane with a focused job.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates comfort outside the web-app layer: CLI design, filesystem-oriented workflows, and practical tooling for repeated developer tasks.
intent: Focused developer-tool example. Maintained when behavior changes or the workflow needs clearer documentation.

title: Crime-NY
summary: Early React map project using NYC OpenData, Mapbox, and year-based exploration of public safety data.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates early interest in visual workflows, public data, mapping interfaces, and user-facing exploration tools.
intent: Early-career work. Presented as foundation and range, not as the current bar for production data products.

title: dogPark
summary: Hackathon prototype around lightweight social and organizational discovery.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates early product collaboration, fast prototyping, and the ability to shape a small idea under time pressure.
intent: Hackathon prototype. Useful as context for collaboration and product instincts, not as a current engineering baseline.

title: SEI-Trivia
summary: Early full-stack trivia project spanning Rails and mobile clients.
whyItMatters: Demonstrates early full-stack training, game-like learning flows, and willingness to work across backend and client surfaces.
intent: Early learning project. It provides background for later interest in study tools and review-game systems.
